spec_match.rationale: Checks the CSS side of the rename with computed values read off real elements — parse checks for both names, effect checks via computed font-stretch, the keyword ladder, and the negative-value rejection — explicitly not trusting CSS.supports alone.

interactive.rationale: A run button executes six live checks and renders the keyword ladder; auto-consistent with re-running, and each row carries its own evidence note.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises the stylesheet side checked against font-stretch with computed read-backs, which is what the page delivers.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers parses-but-does-not-apply, the reverse read direction, keyword acceptance and out-of-range rejection — the full negative surface for a rename.

conformance.rationale: The suite's font-width parse/keyword/computed assertions match these checks one for one; on Chromium 141 /conformance/ honestly reported 2 pass / 5 fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): ran the checks — 2/6 passed (font-stretch control and negative rejection), font-width failed parse and effect with per-row computed evidence ('computed font-stretch was "100%"'), and the detail gave the correct migration advice; console clean, screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and logs pass counts and newName state per run.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, pass/fail as text plus colour, captioned table, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Captioned table with scoped headers, aria-live detail, single labelled 44px button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 (scrollWidth 360, screenshot read).

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/fontface-width-attribute-and-font-width-descriptor/descriptor-parity/ with Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp), which predates the font-width rename. The checks reported the honest pre-154 shape — font-stretch works, font-width fails parse and effect, negative values correctly rejected (2/6) — each row carrying its own computed-style evidence, and the detail giving sound write-both migration advice. Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN artifact; desktop 1280 and mobile 360 DPR3 screenshots read with no overflow; /conformance/ honestly reported 2 pass / 5 fail. Clears the bar.
